title: CDEvalSumm: An Empirical Study of Cross-Dataset Evaluation for Neural Summarization Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying statistical characteristics of text summarization datasets—such as coverage (overlap rate between document and summary), copy length, novelty (proportion of unseen n-grams), repetition, and sentence fusion score—to understand domain differences and evaluate how they affect the cross-dataset generalization of summarization models.
